doc.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

title: Dream band
summary: Gordon's dream band would include Hackett, Teagarden, Condon, Stacy, Wettling and Walter Page, with Russell and Marsala as clarinet subs.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: If you had — oh you probably can’t answer this question, — but if you had a dream band that you could work with for a couple of months and go around the country, do you have specific guys you would pick out?
Yeah, I would have, if they were still alive I would have some of the guys that are passed away now, but —

Well I’d probably have Bobby Hackett or Jack Teagarden and Eddie Condon and Jess Stacy, George Wettling, Walter Page on bass maybe, and I’d have Pee Wee Russell and Joe Marsala as my alternate clarinet players whenever I couldn’t make it.
That would be something to send them in as subs for you.
Well that’s great. Anything else you’d like to add that I haven’t thought about here?
